summary: Phase 3+2 follow-up integration: Budget pre-flight on POST /api/expenses + admin override, approval workflow auto-trigger on submit and AUTO_SUBMIT run-now, /api/branches/{id}/ops-summary, new /app/branch-dashboard, one-time expense modal, and drag-drop bulk doc upload. Backend 6/6 asserted cases pass (3 skipped for env-specific reasons, documented). Frontend: all required data-testids found; live budget pre-flight renders correctly in one-time modal (₹50K travel on Bengaluru HQ → green OK @ 15.4%).

minor.issue: HR admin (hr@acme.io, role=company_admin) cannot exercise the override_budget=true flow end-to-end because the endpoint rejects the request with 400 'Not linked to an employee' before reaching the budget logic. Only admin users who also have an employee_id (i.e. country_head/region_head seeded as employees) can currently submit over-budget expenses with override. The pre-flight /api/budgets/check endpoint still works for admins, so E1's self-test showing block=True is via that endpoint — NOT via POST /api/expenses. This is not a functional bug but an UX limitation worth documenting.

action_items: [LOW] Consider allowing admin roles (company_admin, super_admin) to POST /api/expenses without a linked employee_id, OR explicitly document that admin-override for over-budget expenses requires the admin user to have an employee record. Current behaviour: 400 fires before the override_budget=true branch is reached.
[INFO] Expense item model requires 'expense_date' (not 'date') — already documented in test file; future UI forms must send this field.

[INFO] Procurement POST /api/procurement/po test was skipped because the exact create path differs; the submit-for-approval endpoint itself was reachable and budget_check integration is not independently covered by pytest in this iteration — covered qualitatively via code review of procurement_routes.py ~line 460.
critical_code_review_comments: [OK] expenses_routes.create_expense correctly derives branch_id from employees collection and snapshots budget_check dict into the stored doc — preserved even on admin override (block=true stays in doc for audit).

[OK] expenses_routes.submit_expense wires create_approval_request and persists approval_request_id — verified via /api/expenses/{id}/submit test (approval_request_id populated, status flips to 'submitted').
[OK] branch_ops_routes._create_expense_from_template triggers approval chain for AUTO_SUBMIT mode; run-now idempotency verified via duplicate POST returning same run id.

[OK] branch_ops_routes.branch_ops_summary returns all required keys (branch, fiscal_year, expiring_critical, expiring_soon, recurring_due_next_7d, expenses{*}, budget{*}) — confirmed via shape assertion test.
[INFO] budget_helpers.check_budget returns matched=False/block=False when branch_id/envelope missing — safe default, avoids false blocks. Confirmed via /api/budgets/check test with bogus branch_id.
[INFO] utilization() still does per-branch Python-side sum over expense_claims+purchase_orders — acceptable at current scale but flagged for future aggregation (carried over from iteration 18).

success_rate.backend: 100% of asserted cases (6/6, 3 skipped for env reasons)

test_credentials: hr@acme.io / Hr@12345 (company_admin), employee@acme.io / Employee@123 (linked to employee record)
seed_data_creation: No new seed data. Tests reuse seeded AUTO_SUBMIT recurring templates on Bengaluru HQ branch and FY2027 envelopes. Draft TEST_* expense claims created during small-expense test remain in DB (cleanup not implemented but they are clearly prefixed).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Expense items use 'expense_date' not 'date' in POST /api/expenses payload. Employee 'employee@acme.io' has employee_id linked. HR 'hr@acme.io' may NOT have employee_id → any test that POSTs /api/expenses as HR may 400 before reaching budget logic. For admin override testing, you need a user whose role is in ADMIN=(super_admin, company_admin, country_head, region_head) AND who has an employee record — or call /api/budgets/check directly. /app/branch-dashboard and /app/branch-operations both load fast and all data-testids (bops-onetime-btn, onetime-category, onetime-amount, onetime-budget-check, onetime-submit-btn, docs-bulk-btn, bulk-dropzone, bulk-upload-btn) are present and functional. Budget pre-flight updates live as amount is typed.
rca of the issue: Admin override 400 root cause: /api/expenses requires user.employee_id to be non-null (line ~92 of expenses_routes.py). Company_admin accounts seeded for HR users don't always carry an employee_id since HR is treated as a platform-role, not a headcount. Mitigation: either relax the employee_id guard for admin roles (and route their branch_id via a body field), or seed HR users with linked employee records. Workaround in tests: use employee@acme.io for create_expense tests; use /api/budgets/check for admin-only pre-flight verification.
